Starting the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, then compile a comprehensive report with screenshots.

I have completed the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. 

The overall health score is 52/100. While the site features excellent data visualizations (especially on the Economics and Weather pages) and a clean, consistent design language, there are several critical data quality issues that need immediate attention.

Most notably, future unplayed MLB games are currently showing up in the "Just Happened" section as "FINAL" with 0-0 scores, and the home feed completely lacks the requested "Live Now" and "Upcoming" sections with team logos.

I've compiled all my findings, along with specific actionable recommendations to improve the UX for casual sports fans, into the attached markdown report. I've also included 10 screenshots capturing the various pages and the bugs discovered during the audit.
